transfer_from_invoked.meaning: A spender has called TokenWrapper.transferFrom supplying an approved token owner as the from parameter
transfer_from_invoked.checkpoint: before the Transfer event is emitted by transferFrom

debited_account.meaning: The token holder whose balance decreases in the transferFrom call (the approved token owner supplied as the from parameter)
debited_account.checkpoint: before the Transfer event is emitted by transferFrom

event_from_field.meaning: The address recorded in the from field of the Transfer event emitted by transferFrom
event_from_field.checkpoint: at Transfer event emission by transferFrom

spender_address.meaning: The spender (msg.sender) address that calls transferFrom
spender_address.checkpoint: before the Transfer event is emitted by transferFrom

assumptions: The approved token owner supplied as the from parameter is the account whose balance decreases in the transferFrom call.
The Transfer event is emitted by transferFrom for the described call.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the spender is authorized or the allowance amount; only the from-field mismatch is described, so authorization is not encoded.

limitations: Only the from-field attribution mismatch is formalized; downstream corruption of wallets, indexers, subgraphs, analytics and airdrop scripts is not separately encoded.
No numeric values or bounds are given for the event fields; the relation is purely address correspondence.
